Question: Let \[f(x)=\sum_{k=2}^{10}(\lfloor kx \rfloor -k \lfloor x \rfloor),\] where \(\lfloor r \rfloor\) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to \(r.\) How many distinct values does \(f(x)\) assume for \(x \ge 0?\)
